scenarios.title: Login and rejection
scenarios.assertion: Valid seeded credentials open the account; an incorrect password does not.

scenarios.title: Transaction recipient
scenarios.assertion: A simulated transaction is associated with the selected recipient.

scenarios.title: Amount validation
scenarios.assertion: Invalid amounts are rejected without creating a transaction.

scenarios.title: Transaction history
scenarios.assertion: The submitted amount and description appear in the expected history.

scenarios.title: Filtering
scenarios.assertion: A known seeded transaction appears only under its matching filter.
